events.title: Thai Stock Market Has Flat Lead For Monday's Trade
events.description: The Thai stock market bounced higher again on Friday, one day after ending the three-day winning streak in which it had jumped more than 35 points or 2.5 percent. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,500-point plateau and it's expected to remain in that neighborhood again on Monday.

events.title: Japanese Market Significantly Lower
events.description: The Japanese stock market is significantly lower on Monday after opening in the green, reversing the gains in the previous session, following the mixed cues from Wall Street on Friday. The Nikkei 225 is falling below the 60,500 level, with weakness in exporters and technology stocks partially offset by gains in automakers stocks.

events.title: Rally May Stall For Indonesia Stock Market
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has moved higher in two straight sessions, rallying almost 230 points or 4.5 percent along the way. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just beneath the 5,350-point plateau although it may open in the red on Monday.

events.title: Hong Kong Stock Market Due For Support
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market has tracked lower in three straight sessions, sliding almost 925 points or 3.9 percent in that span. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 23,630-point plateau although it may find traction on Monday.

events.title: Australian Markets Modestly Lower
events.description: The Australian stock market is modestly lower on Monday, extending the losses in the previous two sessions, following the mixed cues from Wall Street on Friday. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is falling well below the 9,100.00 level, with weakness in mining stocks partially offset by gains in technology, energy and financial stocks.

events.title: China Stock Market Stock Market Waiting On Data
events.description: The China stock market has finished lower in consecutive trading days, retreating more than 45 points or 1.2 percent in that span. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just above the 3,630-point plateau and it's looking at a steady start on Monday.

events.title: Tech Shares Likely To Pull Taiwan Stock Market Into The Red
events.description: The Taiwan stock market rebounded on Friday, one day after ending the three-day winning streak in which it had rallied almost 3,550 points or 8.6 percent. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 43,675-point plateau although it may head south again on Monday.

events.title: Little Movement Expected For Singapore Stock Market
events.description: The Singapore stock market has moved in two straight sessions, retreating more than 55 points or 1.1 percent along the way. The Straits Times Index now sits just above the 5,230-point plateau and it may spin its wheels again on Monday.

events.title: Japan Q3 GDP Flat On Quarter
events.description: Japan's gross domestic product was unchanged on quarter in the third quarter of 2026, the Cabinet Office said in Monday's preliminary report.

events.title: Steady Start Seen For Malaysia Stock Market
events.description: The Malaysia stock market has finished lower in five straight sessions, slipping more than 55 points or 3.3 percent in that span. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just above the 1,580-point plateau and it's likely to remain in that neighborhood again on Monday.

events.title: Japan Stock Market May Hand Back Friday's Gains
events.description: The Japan stock market bounced higher again on Friday, one day after ending the three-day winning streak in which it had jumped almost 3,800 points or 5 percent. The Nikkei 225 now sits just above the 61,140-point plateau although it may fade on Monday.

events.title: KOSPI May Spin Its Wheels On Monday
events.description: The South Korea stock market has finished lower in two straight sessions, slumping almost 85 points or 1.6 percent along the way. The KOSPI now sits just above the 5,290-point plateau and it may remain stuck in neutral on Monday.

events.title: China Data Due On Monday
events.description: China is scheduled to release a raft of data on Monday, highlighting a modest day for Asia-Pacific economic activity. On tap are October numbers for industrial production, retail sales, fixed asset investment, house prices and unemployment.
